This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="RJ" /> [[Luntobetha]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TAVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="RJ" /> could sometimes be distinguished by the old [[Bando Gora]] rebreather [[Helmet|masks]]<ref name="TAVG" /> that were attached to devices on their chests via a series of tubes.<ref name="RJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Luntobetha]],<ref name="TAVG" /> worked as a [[clothing]] dyer and vendor on the [[planet]] [[Olega]].<ref name="RJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bandogoracaptain.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Bando Gora design that inspired this species]]
The species made their debut in the [[Revenge / Justice|second episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="RJ" /> According to [[David W. Collins]], this species' design was made in reference to the [[Unidentified Bando Gora captain|Bando Gora captain]] from the [[2002]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'',<ref name="David W. Collins">{{Twitter|DavidWCollins|status/1798374048961077364|[[David W. Collins]]|date=2024-06-05|quote=Lots of fun EU references in #TheAcolyte, including some deep #LucasArts game nods. Anyone notice that #StarWarsBountyBunter Bando Gora-inspired costume in the 2nd episode?|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/o7t6L|archivefile=File:DavidWCollins-TheAcolyte-BandoGora-Twitter.png}} {{Twitter|DavidWCollins|status/1798375525326688480|[[David W. Collins]]|date=2024-06-05|quote=Shop vendor selling Osha her cloak|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/Ym1qB|archivefile=File:DavidWCollins-TheAcolyte-BandoGora-Twitter.png}}</ref><ref name="Bounty Hunters">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> a connection that was later made [[canon]] via the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref>
